## Description

Context: what we decided and why. People and the plan belong to the organisation, so one doctor or nurse can work at several branches. The plan cap counts them once (MDV-P1-069). Overlap: MDV-P7-003 and MDV-P7-002 (facility scope for hospital roles) extend this for hospital departments later.
What to build. A membership gets a set of locations within the organisation (today one facility; MDV-P1-009 scoped it). The owner assigns locations when adding or editing staff and doctors, and invitations carry them. The facility picker lists only the member's locations. Schedule, reception board and queue stay per location; a doctor with two locations has one schedule template per location. Reassigning or walking a patient between doctors of different locations is out of scope. Offboarding removes access at every location at once.
Touched: Medvya.Tenancy.Infrastructure/StaffAccess.cs, Invitations.cs, Doctors.cs, membership and facility scope in Medvya.Tenancy, Medvya.Identity.Api/StaffEndpoints.cs, Medvya.Scheduling (SchedulingAccess.cs, schedule, board, queue by location), web/clinic staff, doctors and facility picker, i18n, ERD.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given an owner edits a staff member, when they pick two locations, then the member can switch between them in the picker and sees only those.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a member without a location, when they call an endpoint for that location, then 403 (server-side).
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a doctor at two locations, when the reception board or queue opens at one location, then it shows only that location's visits.
- [ ] **AC4.** Given a member is offboarded, when it is saved, then access ends at every location immediately.
- [ ] **AC5.** Given the starter plan, when the same person is at two locations, then they count once.

## Test notes

- Unit: location scope in capability checks.
- Integration on real PostgreSQL: scope refusal, picker list, offboarding at all locations, board per location.
- Playwright: staff with two locations switch picker; board differs per location.
- Security: authorisation on each endpoint; no cross-organisation leak; ponytail-review.
- Browser: English and Arabic, axe clean.
